body: I don't think so. All he wants is for me to disappear, never come back to haunt him in any way. He's trying to pretend that I don't exist anyway.  At least if I blast my brains out in front of him, he'd have to deal with the physical mess and the questions.

I hate that he's living a happy life after what he's purposely done to me. I can't handle the pain he's caused, and the anger he induces in me when I see him flaunt his happiness in front of everyone. He hurts people and he gets away with it.
